spans.s: शुश्रू f. A mother.

शुश्रूषक a. Attentive, obedient.
--कः A servant, an attendant.

शुश्रूषणं, --णा [श्रु-सन् ल्युट]
1
Desire to hear.
--2 Service, attendance.
--3 Obedience, dutifulness.

शुश्रूषणं, --णा [श्रु-सन् ल्युट]
1
Desire to hear.
--2 Service, attendance.
--3 Obedience, dutifulness.

1 Desire to hear; अत एव
शुश्रूषा मां मुखरयति
Mu. 3

.
--2
Service, attendance.
--3 Dutifulness,
obedience.
--4 Reverence.
--5
Telling, saying.

शुश्रूषु a.
1 Desirous to hear.
--2
Desirous of serving or attending.
--3
Obedient, attentive.

शुष् {c4c} P. (शुष्यति, शुष्क)
1 To be
dried, become dry or parched up;
तृषा शुष्यत्यास्ये पिबति सलिलं स्वादु
सुरभि

.
--2 to be withered.
--3
To languish, become emaciated;

.
--4 To be afflicted or
distressed. --Caus. (शोषयति-ते)
1 To dry
up, wither, parch; न शोषयति मारुतः

.
--2 To emaciate.
--3 To
destroy.
--4 To extinguish.
--5 To
drain, suck up, absorb.
--6 To
exhaust, empty. --WITH उद --परि
1
to be dried up, dry up;

.
--2 to pine, decay, wither.
-वि, -सं to be dried up.

शूष् {c1c} P. (शूषति)
1 To produce,
beget.
--2 To bring forth.

सूष् {c1c} P. (सूषति) To bring forth,
bear, produce, beget.

शुषः, --शुषी
1 Drying, drying up.
--2 A hole in the ground.

शुषः, --शुषी
1 Drying, drying up.
--2 A hole in the ground.

शुषिः f.
1 Drying up.
--2 A hole.
--3 The hollow in the fang of a
snake.

सुषिः f.
1 A hole; cf. शुषि.
--2 A
tube, pipe.

शुषिर a. [शुष् किरच्] Full of
holes, perforated.
--रः
1 Fire.
--2 A
rat or mouse.
--रं
1 A hole.
--2 The
atmosphere.
--3 A
wind-instrument.

1 A river.
--2 A sort of
perfume.

सुषिर a.
1 Full of holes, hollow,
perforated.
--2 Slow in articulation.
--रं
1 A hole, an aperture, a cavity.
--2 Any wind-instrument.
शुषिलः Air, wind.

शुष्क p. p. [शुष्-क्त]
1 Dry,
dried up; शाखायां शुष्कं करिष्यामि
Mk. 8

.
--2 Parched up, sear.
--3
Shrivelled, shrunk up, emaciated.
--4
Feigned, pretended, mock; कामिनः
स्म कुरुते करभोरूर्हारि शुष्करुदितं च
सुखेऽपि Śi. 10. 69.
--5 Empty, vain,
useless, unproductive;

.
--6
Groundless, causeless.
--7 Offensive,
harsh; तस्मै नाकुशलं ब्रूयान्न शुष्कां
गिरमीरयेत्

.
--Comp.
--अंग a. emaciated.
--(गी) a lizard.
--अन्नं rice in the husk.
--आर्द्रं dry
ginger.
--कलहः {1} a vain or
groundless quarrel. {2} a mock quarrel;
Mu. 3

.
--वैरं groundless enmity.
--व्रणं a
healed wound, scar.

शुष्कलः, --लं
1 Dried flesh.
--2
Flesh in general.

शुष्कलः, --लं
1 Dried flesh.
--2
Flesh in general.

1 The sun.
--2 Fire.

शुष्मः [शुष् --मन् किच्च]
1 The sun.
--2 Fire.
--3 Air, wind.
--4 A bird.
--ष्मं
1 Prowess, strength.
--2 Light,
lustre.

शुष्मन् m.
1 Fire; Śi. 14. 22.
--2
The Citraka tree. --n.
1 Strength,
prowess.
--2 Light, lustre.
सुष्मं A rope, cord, string.

शुष्मिन् a.
1 Powerful, strong.
--2
Fiery, high-mettled (as a horse)

सुषम a.
1 Very lovely or
beautiful, very pleasing.
--2 Same; all.
--मा Exquisite beauty, great lustre
or splendour; कुरबककुसुमं चपलासुषमं
Gīt. 7

; सुषमाविषये परक्षिणे निखिलं
पद्ममभाजि तन्मुखात्
Bv. 1

1 A sort of gourd.
--2
Black cumin.
--3 Cumin-seed.
सुषाढः An epithet of Śiva.

सुषि(षी)म a.
1 Cold, frigid.
--2 Pleasant, agreeable.
--मः
1 Cold.
--2 A kind of snake.
--3 The
moonstone.

सुषि(षी)म a.
1 Cold, frigid.
--2 Pleasant, agreeable.
--मः
1 Cold.
--2 A kind of snake.
--3 The
moonstone.

सुषुप्तिः f.
1 Deep or profound
sleep, profound repose.
--2 Great
insensibility, spiritual ignorance;
अविद्यात्मिका हि
बीजशक्तिरव्यक्तशब्दनिर्देश्या परमेश्वराश्रया मायामयी
महासुषुप्तिर्यस्यां स्वरूपप्रतिबोधरहिताः शेरते
संसारिणो जीवाः Ś. B. on Br.

सुषुम्णः N. of one of the
principal rays of the sun.
--म्णा A
particular artery of the human
body, said to lie between इडा and
पिंगला, two of the vessels of the
body.

1 N. of a tree(करमर्द)
--2 N. of Viṣṇu.
--3 A cane or
ratan.

सुष्ठु ind.
1 Well, excellently,
beautifully.
--2 Very much,
exceedingly; सुष्ठु शोभसे आर्यपुत्र एतेन
विनयमाहात्म्येन

.
--3 Truly, rightly;
शब्दः सुष्ठु प्रयुक्तः Sarva. S.; अथवा
सुष्ठु खल्विदमुच्यते.
सूषणा A mother.

सूष्यती A woman about to be
confined, one who is parturient.
